blurb: The sanctuary of Zeus where the Olympic Games were held for over a thousand years.

facts.t: The Greeks counted the first Games from 776 BC, when a cook named Koroibos won the only event, a sprint of one stadium, about 192 metres. Later writers kept the list of winners.
Since 1936 the Olympic flame for every Games has been lit here with a curved mirror and the sun, at the Temple of Hera.
